series.name: clBasis
series.description: Front-month crude futures minus physical spot (use CL); negative: backwardation

series.name: cotCrude
series.description: Weekly net futures positions by trader category (use CL, interval 1w); producers and merchants are the rest

series.name: clInventory
series.description: Commercial crude oil inventories (use CL, interval 1w); fall when the price rises

series.name: freight
series.description: Dry bulk freight index (points) and the soybean export price spread, origin B minus origin A FOB (USD per tonne); use ZS

series.name: powerLoad
series.description: Daily average power demand, wind and solar output of a grid (use NG, interval 1d)

series.name: euaBalance
series.description: Weekly carbon allowance balance, supply minus verified emissions (use EUA, interval 1w); a deficit lifts the price

series.name: tempAnomaly
series.description: Daily population-weighted temperature anomaly against the seasonal normal (use NG, interval 1d); cold lifts gas
